plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Delegate to Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as an autonomous subagent: planning, adversarial review, evidence-based audits, cited web research and session summaries. Optional voice narration (local Voicebox) and push notifications to your own Telegram bot, both inactive until you add credentials. Unofficial; not affiliated with Google.
